description: This Java class 'EnumToString' processes C header files containing enum definitions to generate corresponding C++ code for converting enum values to strings. It reads enum definitions, extracts enum constants, and generates switch-case functions and header content for use in C/C++ projects.

classes.name: EnumToString
classes.description: Main class that reads C enum definitions from a header file and generates C++ source and header files with functions to convert enum values to strings.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments, initializes file content, and triggers processing of the input header file.

methods.name: writeCppAndHeaderFiles
methods.description: Writes the generated C++ code and header content to output files.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads the input header file, extracts enum definitions, and generates corresponding C++ code for each enum.

methods.name: removeSpaces
methods.description: Removes all whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: isKeyValueLine
methods.description: Checks if a line matches the pattern of an enum constant declaration.

methods.name: makeCode
methods.description: Generates C++ switch-case code for converting enum values to strings based on collected enum constants.

methods.name: getMethodSignature
methods.description: Constructs the method signature string for enum-to-string conversion functions.

methods.name: capitalize
methods.description: Capitalizes the first letter of the enum name for method naming.
